core_obligations: Use openness of etale maps to descend semi-continuity to a scheme cover.
Identify the fibre-dimension function along a surjective etale presentation of X.
difficulty_reason: For f : X -> Y flat and of finite presentation between spaces over S, the function n_{X/Y} on Y recording fibre dimensions (constructed in the base-change-dimension-fibres lemma) is lower semi-continuous. The retained proof: test after a surjective etale map g : V -> Y with V a scheme — since |g| is open, lower semi-continuity of the pullback function implies that of n_{X/Y}; shrink V affine, take a surjective etale U -> X with U an affine scheme; the equality n_{X/Y} = n_{U/Y} (dimensions are etale-invariant along the cover) reduces to the schemes statement (More on Morphisms, dimension-fibres-flat). Retained author proof at lines 7213-7224.
